sections.content: @media queries adapt CSS (and thus HTML layout expectations) to conditions: screen width, print, dark mode, reduced motion.
For printing, browsers offer print-specific styles: hide nav/buttons, expand links, avoid page-break inside cards. Users print documentation and receipts — design for paper too.
Key points: mobile-first media queries (min-width), prefers-reduced-motion respects accessibility settings, and @page controls print margins.
